data.standardized_narrative: At 1 January 2022 the syndicate carried gross claims outstanding of GBP 3,291.5m. During 2022 there was a net favourable prior-year development (release) reported on net incurred losses of GBP 82.5m. The release was largely driven by favourable prior year experience in London Specialty and reductions in reserves on legacy catastrophe events (notably Hurricane Ida, COVID and Typhoon Hagibis). Offsetting factors during the year included material 2022 catastrophe losses (Hurricane Ian and the Russia-Ukraine conflict) and an increased allowance for claims inflation; overall the syndicate reports a mixture of catastrophe-driven current-year losses and favourable prior-year reserve developments.
raw_causal_phrases: This catastrophe experience was in part offset by prior year releases from London Specialty due to favourable loss experience.

as more information and claims experience has developed on certain legacy catastrophe events, there has been a reduction in reserves (namely Hurricane Ida (net GBP 32.9m), COVID (net GBP 13.3m) and Japanese Typhoon Hagibis (net GBP 10.7m)).
The elevated economic inflation outlook and its effect on claims inflation was one of the key areas of reserving uncertainty facing the Syndicate during 2022.
The prior year development on net incurred losses for the 2022 financial year is a favourable movement of GBP 82.5m (2021: GBP 166.7m deterioration).
data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding taken from Statement of Financial Position (Liabilities) at 1 January 2022 (gross). No explicit GROSS prior-year development movement line was found; the report explicitly states a net favourable prior year development of GBP 82.5m and a by-line net breakdown by class - the gross prior-year movement is not provided. The prior_year_development_gbp_m therefore uses the stated NET prior-year development (fallback source) and is flagged accordingly. A gross claims development triangle is present in the report but extraction/parsing of the gross triangle was ambiguous in the provided text; gross PYD was not calculated from the triangle in this extraction.
